# vscode-3d

> Preview GLB and glTF models inside VS Code, try 2,800 library animations or a text-described motion on any rig and bake the result, generate and refine models from a prompt on the free three.ws lane, optimize for the web, diff a model against git, AI quality-check a render, and get diagnostics and completions for <agent-3d> embeds. Powered by three.ws.

vscode-3d is a JavaScript library from three.ws. Install: `npm install vscode-3d`.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/nirholas/vscode-3d/blob/main/README.md): install, configuration, full reference
- [Documentation site](https://nirholas.github.io/vscode-3d/): the README as a web page
- [Full text for LLMs](https://nirholas.github.io/vscode-3d/llms-full.txt): README inlined
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/nirholas/vscode-3d/blob/main/AGENTS.md): guidance for coding agents
